messages:
Maria: quick heads-up — spotted a cluster of near-duplicates in the holdout used for the quant4B bring-up. looks like synthetic augmentation duplicated some prompts. i paused the sampler. need a short de-dup + golden audit so we don't regress evals.
Kevin: thanks. can you drop 3 example ids and the s3 prefix? i'll run a fingerprint pass.
Maria: s3://redwood-datasets/curation/quant4b/holdout/
example ids: q4b-24931, q4b-24933, q4b-24976
Anika: will coordinate labelers — do we want to remove duplicates from the holdout or move them to a reserve bucket?
Evan: moving to reserve is safer for now, keeps historical signal. we should also regenerate the metrics after de-dupe.
Kevin: running a fuzzy fingerprint with threshold 0.86 now:
```
python infra/fingerprint.py --src s3://redwood-datasets/curation/quant4b/holdout --out /tmp/fp.csv --threshold 0.86
```
Kevin: quick result — ~412 candidates flagged, 72 exact-level duplicates, 340 near-duplicates (similar paraphrases).
Maria: rough plan: 1) move exact duplicates to s3://redwood-datasets/curation/quant4b/reserve/exact/ 2) near-duplicates -> reserve/near/ for manual review 3) re-run holdout sampling to fill gaps 4) rerun evals for quant4b and quant4b-int8.
Anika: LabelingBot creating tasks for the near-duplicate review, batching by fingerprint cluster size <= 5.
LabelingBot: created task group #LD-4821 (340 items) assigned to team-curation, eta 48h. :white_check_mark:
Evan: also flag any items that are golden candidates (we shouldn't move golden examples). Maria, do you have the golden list for this holdout?
Maria: yes — golden list v20240328 in repo: `gs://redwood-golden/quant4b/golden_v20240328.csv`. i'll run an anti-join against the fp results and protect those.
Kevin: patched script to skip golden ids and to emit a migration plan:
```
# pseudo
fp = load('/tmp/fp.csv')
golden = load('gs://redwood-golden/quant4b/golden_v20240328.csv')
fp = fp[~fp.id.isin(golden.ids)]
plan = fp.groupby('cluster').apply(assign_move)
plan.to_csv('/tmp/migration_plan.csv')
```
Anika: once LabelingBot tasks finish, i'll do a quick QC sweep on a random 500 samples. if pass, we swap the holdout objects and tag the new holdout commit. i'll coordinate with release to trigger evals.
Evan: for evals — let's run: baseline (current hosted model), quant4b float, quant4b int8. compare BLEU/ROUGE and the promptset-specific micro-metrics. i'll post the eval checklist.
Maria: timeline: de-dup pass + labeler review 48–72h, holdout regen + evals by EOD Friday if no blockers.
Kevin: FYI i logged a small bug in the sampler — it didn't respect the augmentation origin tag, so duplicates slipped in. i'll open a PR to make origin tracking immutable.
Anika: thanks. i'll follow up with labelers and ping here with LD-4821 progress. :pray:
Maria: perfect — thanks everyone. i'll attach the fp CSV and migration_plan to the task group when ready.
